title: Connection-Allowlist doesn't have effect
body:

### Electron Version

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

MacOS

### What arch are you using?

arm64 (including Apple Silicon)

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

Yes

### Expected Behavior

1. I enable the connection allowlist feature
```js
app.commandLine.appendSwitch("enable-features", "ConnectionAllowlists");
```
2. Set header value as `Connection-Allowlist: ()`
3. Got error for every API: WebSocket, EventSource, fetch, WebRTC, etc.


### Actual Behavior

1. Any of the connection could be established
2. No errors in console
